object.attr: analysis: INSTALL.md lists Git for Windows for the git client that pulls and pushes, and doesn't say whether Mellon needs it. MELLON-GUI-SRS-225 makes it hold by construction. Where a commit's author comes from on a clean machine is VER's (review Q30).
object.description: Mellon installed by the Windows installer shall open, edit and commit a repository on a machine without a git program.
